body:
Step B0 of the multi-account design (, section 7). Move-only: after this ticket the app
behaves identically, the same tests pass, and the data layer lives in a module that cannot see
Android.

## What

* New Gradle module `android/core` (`kotlin("jvm")`, kotlinx-serialization, Room KSP with
  `BundledSQLiteDriver`, `javax.inject:javax.inject`). It has **no Android SDK on its classpath**;
  that is the enforcement, not a lint rule. Allowed `androidx.*`: only `androidx.room` and
  `androidx.sqlite` (both are Kotlin Multiplatform). Forbidden: `android.*`, every other
  `androidx.*`, `dagger.*`. Tolerated for now, listed per file in `core/README.md` and removed in
  B5: `retrofit2.http` annotations on `Api`, `okhttp3.Interceptor` in the three interceptors,
  `javax.inject.Inject` on constructors.
* Move into `:core` unchanged apart from the package prefix and the split below:
  `data/api/{Api,Dto,Protocol,AuthInterceptor,ErrorInterceptor,SessionEvents}.kt`,
  `data/db/{AppDb (the @Database class + DAOs + entities), LwwField, Status, Transactions}.kt`,
  `data/repo/*`, `data/sync/{SyncEngine,Syncer,SyncStatus,SyncTrigger,CollaboratorChangeNotifier}.kt`,
  `data/{AppFormat,AppLocale,CategoryCanon,Expense,ExpenseMath,ListKind,NameOrder}.kt`,
  `data/update/{UpdateChecker (minus its Context use, see below),VersionCompare}.kt`.
* Split, never rewrite: a file that mixes a Hilt module or a `Context` with portable code is
  cut in two. The `@Module` classes (`SessionModule`, the db module in `AppDb.kt`, `ServerConfig`'s
  DataStore provider, `SyncTriggerModule`, `ApiProvider`'s Retrofit assembly) stay in `:app`;
  the classes they bind move. `Room.databaseBuilder(context, …)` and the `Migration` objects
  stay in `:app`. `AuthRepository`'s `android.os.Build` use becomes a constructor parameter
  (`deviceName: String`). `SessionState`/`TokenProvider` interfaces move, `SessionStore`
  (EncryptedSharedPreferences) stays.
* Interfaces `:core` needs from the platform are declared in `:core` and implemented in `:app`:
  `SyncTrigger` already is one; add `Clock` only if a moved class calls `System.currentTimeMillis`
  through something Android-specific (otherwise leave it).
* `CollaboratorChangeNotificationPoster` imports `ui.localizedContext`; it stays in `:app`.
* Tests: pure JUnit tests of moved classes (`ExpenseMathTest`, `CategoryCanonTest`,
  `NameOrderTest`, `VersionCompareTest`, price parsing, and the shared-table readers) move to
  `core/src/test` and read `shared-test-cases/*.json` from the repo root as today. Tests that
  need Robolectric (Room via `Context`, MockWebServer with the Hilt graph, screens) stay in
  `:app` and test the moved classes across the module boundary. Count the tests before and after;
  the number must not drop.
* `verify-all.sh` runs `:core:test` alongside the app tasks; `release.sh` is untouched (versions
  live in `:app`). `android/README.md` describes the two modules; AGENTS.md gets one bullet
  under "Both clients, always" or a new "Android modules" section: **`:core` has no Android on
  its classpath; put platform code behind an interface in `:app`.**

## Review checklist (orchestrator)

* `git diff -M --stat` shows renames, not add/delete pairs, for every moved file.
* No file in `:core` imports a forbidden package (grep the list above).
* Test count unchanged or higher; `./verify-all.sh` green; APK builds (`assembleRelease`, offline).
* Room schema file `9.json` does **not** appear: the schema is unchanged in B0.
title: Android core module: move the data layer into :core with no Android on its classpath (B0)
